```markdown
# Positioning

## What we sell

Their own sentence, from the profile note: "one place the whole team writes
down what it decided and why". Ours: a written record of the decisions a small
marketing team makes, kept where the team already works.

## Who it is for

The companies named in the ideal customer profile at
context/strategy/icp.md, which is to say software companies of twenty to two
hundred people with one or two people doing all of the marketing.

## What makes it different

The record is written the day the decision is made rather than reconstructed at
the end of the quarter. The profile note says it plainly: "nobody can answer the
question at the start of a quarter". Nothing else in the material supports a
second claim, so there is only one here.

## Their own words

"one place the whole team writes down what it decided and why"
"nobody can answer the question at the start of a quarter"
"every prospect asked for the monthly number anyway"
```
